title: The way in
starting_code: # Walk up to the door. It wants its password, and its seal broken!
hints: You have everything you need: a move, a word, and a spell.
First walk up to the door, then say the password and cast your spell.
Use `say` for the password, and `cast` for the seal, before taking the last step in.
intro: Here we are! Up the steps is the castle's great door. It is sealed by a rune, and it also listens for the school's word. We need everything we have learned!
outro: The door is opening onto the dark hall. We did it! Let us go inside.
